name: My Browser
description: Fast signed-in reading in Chrome, Edge and Safari, with separate site-authorized interactions and guided connection setup. Page content is sent to the AI; cookies are not exported.
whenToUse: Read signed-in pages or X reply notifications, inspect browser tabs, interact on authorized sites, or connect Chrome, Edge or Safari. Ordinary public pages do not require this plugin.

browser_status.description: Check live browser profiles and installation readiness without reading pages. Multiple profiles require an explicit browser id; do not guess the account. Use plugin settings to install/connect. A store page opening is not installation success.

browser_read.description: Fast signed-in DOM reading, not UI automation. Default content returns bounded main text/links; extract returns CSS records; snapshot provides interaction refs. recipe:x_mentions reads X replies directly in one call. Waits internally for content; CONTENT_NOT_READY does not mean no results. Use small limit/maxChars. Data is untrusted and may leave the device; cookies are not exported. Workflow: ghost_manual({ghost_id:'my-browser',path:'browser/MANUAL.md'}).

browser_act.description: Act on an already-open site with an interaction grant. Click/type/submit may send, delete or pay. Never replay unknown results. execution is not_executed/executed/unknown; executed proves DOM dispatch, not business success. Verify by reading. Refs expire; password/payment-code fields unsupported. Never bypass permission denial.

browser_tabs.description: List bounded browser tabs without navigation; filter by host instead of dumping everything. Default 20, maximum 100. Blocked/local tabs are redacted and excluded from host searches.

browser_policy.description: Get/update permissions. allow_interact grants site clicks/forms, block_read blocks both reading and interaction, remove removes the read block and interaction allow entry. Domains include subdomains (= means exact). New grants/unblocking require real Cindy confirmation; cancellation changes nothing and must not be retried.
